title: Knowledge Overview
description: Structured knowledge base overview produced by Phase 2 (Concept Extraction). Contains extracted concepts with relationships, thematic groupings, key findings, knowledge gaps, and open questions. Extracted from the existing KnowledgeOverview TypeScript interface in concepts-collector/types.ts.

title.description: Descriptive title for the knowledge overview

status.description: Draft during extraction, complete after Claude fills in the template

sources.description: Research items that contributed to this overview

summary.description: Executive summary synthesizing all source material

key_findings.description: Actionable insights derived from the analysis

knowledge_gaps.description: Areas where available research is insufficient or contradictory

open_questions.description: Questions worth investigating that emerged from the analysis

name.description: Clear, specific name for the concept

description.description: What this concept is and why it matters

key_details.description: Specific details, numbers, parameters, or implementation notes

source_items.description: Item IDs from the source collection that contributed to this concept

oneOf.description: Simple string descriptions of relationships to other concepts
Structured relationship objects with target concept and relationship type

relationships.description: How this concept relates to others in the overview. Supports both string and structured formats.

description.description: What unifies the concepts in this theme

concept_names.description: Names of concepts belonging to this theme
